name: Koi ni wa Amae ga Hitsuyou Desu
original_name: 恋にはあまえが必要です
source:
Losing his father when he was young, and currently lives with his mother, the protagonist―― [b]Morino Kento[/b].

In his second year at Aketo Hanabue Private Academy, he goes on a school trip which takes him far away from his hometown, to a place filled with exotic tourist attractions.

But at that destination, Kento's cousin lives there, and it is a town where he is already familiar with, so he does not expect anything much, however......

Caught up in a commotion caused by [b]Shishikura Ouga[/b]―― An extremely shy childhood friend who comes from the strongest lineage in human history.

Helping a girl in trouble, becoming a "hero" for [b]Karakuchi Hibana[/b]―― An ojousama who visits the same tourist attraction by chance on the school trip.

Getting acquainted with [b]Amaeda Chiwa[/b]―― A cute local student and his cousin's best friend.

Earning respect as a "hero" from [b]Aijou Michiru[/b]―― A signboard girl in the shopping district at the tourist attraction.

What should have been a school trip with nothing to expect turns out to be an exciting trip filled with new encounters.

However, when such a trip comes to an end in the blink of an eye, parting ways with these girls (except Ouga), Kento feels a bit lonely.

[b]But with the end of such trip―― from now on with these girls, comes the start of the new love stories[/b].

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206724]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
幼年丧父、目前与母亲同住的主人公——[b]Morino Kento[/b]。

他就读于Aketo Hanabue私立学园二年级，一次修学旅行将他带到远离家乡、观光景点丰富的异地。

目的地正是Kento表亲居住的城镇，而且他对那里也很熟悉，因此并未期待能有什么新鲜事……

他却卷入了[b]Shishikura Ouga[/b]引发的骚动。Ouga是个极度怕生的青梅竹马，来自人类史上最强大的血脉。

旅途中，他帮助陷入困境的女孩，成为同一景点偶遇的大小姐[b]Karakuchi Hibana[/b]心目中的“英雄”。

他还结识了天真可爱的当地学生[b]Amaeda Chiwa[/b]，她是表亲的好友。

在旅游景点附近的商业街上，他又因一场“英雄救美”赢得了看板娘[b]Aijou Michiru[/b]的敬重。

这趟原本没抱任何期待的修学旅行，变成了一场充满新邂逅的精彩旅程。

然而转眼间旅行结束，除了Ouga以外，他不得不与这些女孩分别，心中感到一丝寂寞。

[b]但随着旅程落幕——他与这些女孩的新恋情也将从此展开。[/b]
